name: Raven-Oncall
description: A powerful on-call agent that can run a long job on a remote machine and keep watching it, deciding on its own when to look again, resubmit, kill it, or file a report. Use this agent when the work outlives the conversation. IMPORTANT: the spawn returns after the first turn, not when the job finishes.
owns: owns long-running or remote jobs that outlive this conversation. Do not run one yourself.
